text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to the infirmary with Red Desire, 
who got injured during training.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your trouble. I am deeply 
grateful for your prompt response.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, the injury was minor and has 
already been treated, so let us return to 
training.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I am well aware of that. 
However, I am a saint.
choice_data_list: いや、ケガしてるんだけど！？

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It is our fate that hardship will always 
lie ahead. If I cannot overcome a trial of 
this measure, how could I ever call myself 
a Saint?!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
So please believe in me. Believe that we 
will overcome this without fail.
choice_data_list:
No, even if it's the long way around, 
let's rest for now.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...So you truly do not believe in me, do 
you?"
choice_data_list: いや、遠回りになっても、今は休もう
choice_data_list_en: No, even if it's the long way around, let's rest for now.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Because... you believe in me...? Then why 
tell me to rest...
choice_data_list: 違う。信じているから休んでもらうんだ
違うよ。信じているから休んでもらうんだ
choice_data_list_en: No. I'm having you rest because I believe in you.
That's not it. I'm having you rest because I believe in you.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...In other words, even if I pause here, I 
will certainly reach 'that place.' Is that 
what you are trying to say?
choice_data_list: 休息くらいで、君の道は閉ざされない
休息くらいで、貴方の道は閉ざされないよ
choice_data_list_en: A little rest won't close off your path.
A little rest won't close off your path, you know.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah! ...Ufufu, understood. Then I shall 
place my trust in you as well, 
Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: ああ、君は聖女だからな
うん、貴方は聖女だからね
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, you are a saint, after all.
Yeah, you are a saint, after all.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Using this brief moment of rest as 
nourishment, I will shine even brighter as 
a holy maiden...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, as I thought, you truly are a person 
worthy of walking alongside me.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us continue our training. Allow 
me to show you the full potential of a 
saint!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Kh, but... I am not one to succumb to this 
level of pain...! J-Just one more—
choice_data_list:
...Isn't admitting it's reckless also part 
of the trial?

...Isn't admitting something is reckless a 
kind of trial in itself?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: That... might be true...
choice_data_list: ……無茶だと認めるのも試練じゃないか？
……無茶だと認めるのも試練じゃないかな？
choice_data_list_en: ...Admitting it's reckless is a trial too, isn't it?
...Isn't admitting it's reckless a trial too?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood. For now, I shall simply 
face this pain..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her pain flaring back up, Red Desire 
ended up taking some time off to rest.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Hah, whew...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there's no pain even after moving 
this much. It seems I have overcome this 
trial.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you so much for believing 
in me!
choice_data_list:
Still, just to be safe, let's keep things 
light for the rest.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let us proceed carefully, with your 
words as our guide.
choice_data_list: でも念のため、あとは軽めでいこう
choice_data_list_en: Still, just to be safe, let's take it easy the rest of the way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to gradually easing her body back 
into it, Red Desire made a smooth and 
steady comeback.
